description: This source file contains the implementation of a test runner class 'DisabledCallChainReentrancyTestRunner' for testing non-reentrant grain behaviors in an Orleans actor-based system. It includes methods that execute various grain interactions and invoke assertions based on expected behaviors such as deadlocks or timeouts.

classes.name: DisabledCallChainReentrancyTestRunner
classes.description: A test runner class designed to execute and verify behaviors of non-reentrant Orleans grains under various conditions.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrain
methods.description: Tests a non-reentrant grain for deadlock or timeout conditions.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrain_WithMayInterleaveStaticPredicate_WhenPredicateReturnsFalse
methods.description: Tests a grain with a static predicate for reentrancy behavior when the predicate returns false.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrain_WithMayInterleaveInstancedPredicate_WhenPredicateReturnsFalse
methods.description: Tests a grain with an instanced predicate for reentrancy behavior when the predicate returns false.

methods.name: UnorderedNonReentrantGrain
methods.description: Tests an unordered non-reentrant grain for deadlock or timeout conditions.
